about_short_description.short_description: Waydev is the software development analytics intelligence tool for engineering leaders

product.name: Waydev Developer Productivity Insight Platform
product.description: A software engineering analytics platform that combines development-tool data to measure delivery performance, team health, developer productivity, and engineering resource use.

product.name: Waydev AI
product.description: An AI-native engineering intelligence product that answers questions about delivery, productivity, and AI usage through conversational analysis, custom reports, and editable queries.

identifier.value: Waydev Business Alignment and Executive Reporting

product.name: Waydev Business Alignment and Executive Reporting
product.description: Reporting and planning capabilities that connect engineering initiatives with business objectives through resource planning, project-cost analysis, investment tracking, and cost capitalization.

product.name: Waydev Developer Experience (DX) Analytics
product.description: A developer experience analysis capability that uses team surveys and engineering data to identify contributors’ frustrations, blockers, sentiment, and workflow challenges.

product.name: Waydev Integrations and API
product.description: Data integration services that connect Waydev with source-control, ticketing, CI/CD, calendar, and other engineering systems, with an API for exchanging organization-specific data.

identifier.value: Waydev Professional Services and Customer Success

product.name: Waydev Professional Services and Customer Success
product.description: Implementation and adoption support for configuring Waydev, interpreting engineering metrics, and helping organizations use the platform for engineering efficiency and business planning.
